name: Summer Senses Luxury Resort
insider_take: This Six Senses sanctuary on Paros captures the essence of Cycladic luxury while honoring the island's authentic fishing village charm.
whats_special: Summer Senses sits on pristine Parikia Bay, where the resort's infinity pools seem to merge with the Aegean Sea. The property features traditional Cycladic architecture with white-washed buildings and blue accents, plus an award-winning spa using locally-sourced ingredients like Parian marble and sea salt. Paros is famous for its translucent Parian marble - the same marble used to sculpt Venus de Milo and Napoleon's tomb.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner on the resort's clifftop terrace - Paros offers some of the most spectacular sunsets in the Cyclades, and you'll have front-row seats without the crowds of Santorini.
dont_miss: Explore the charming fishing village of Naoussa just 10 minutes away, with its Venetian harbor and octopus drying in the sun. Take a boat trip to the nearby uninhabited island of Antiparos to see the famous stalactite cave, or visit the ancient marble quarries that supplied stone to classical Greek temples.
pros: Stunning Cycladic architecture with panoramic Aegean Sea views
Award-winning Six Senses spa with holistic wellness programs
Exceptional farm-to-table dining featuring local Paros ingredients
Private beach access with crystal-clear waters and water sports
cons: Remote location requires transportation to Paros town center
